name: Rapid7 aggregate GitHub and freelance-account graph

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed public security research; legal adjudication, civil-identity finding, and same-operator scope remain unresolved.

caveats: Rapid7's readable public report exposes its public text; node labels are missing from the readable report, and this record carries no guessed handles or individual profiles.
The graph is an aggregate vendor assessment; applying it to every neighboring developer, project, or security profile requires separate evidence.

statements: Rapid7 reports an in-depth investigation that correlated personal-data overlap, infrastructure reuse, code-repository handles, and shared social-graph patterns across DPRK-affiliated IT-worker profiles on freelance and outsourcing platforms. Its Figure 3 depicts multiple GitHub-centered clusters connected by shared projects, code, friends, and other relationships.
